name: Lucid Bots
long_description: At Lucid, we are a B2B robotics company for dull, dirty, and dangerous jobs, starting with exterior cleaning and painting, an industry with a 200% annual turnover rate. Our primary product is a drone that cleans windows, roofs, stadiums, and industrial tanks for cleaning companies, facilities teams, and industrial customers around the country. More than 600 of our drones are in the field today. We engineer, manufacture, and support the technology from a 23,000 square foot headquarters in Charlotte, NC, and are moving into a 45,000 square foot facility in early 2027.
one_liner: Drones that clean and paint up to 8x faster
